law: Independent LogUniform[1/3,3] factors for all generators and four-period groups; feature=3*generator+block, shared by all four u/v/w/p cost components.
seed_derivation: little-endian first16 SHA256 bytes of UTF8(namespace + '|physical_seed=' + decimal seed); does not depend on model hashes or observed results
physical_model: Same sealed original G4T12 model. Original fuelUniform[22,45], onUniform[80,240], shutdownUniform[5,30]. Startup=capacity*(22+(original_startup-220)*38/630), a synthetic rateUniform[22,60] per MW. Demand curve fraction[0.30,0.50].
startup_interpretation: NREL Table1-2 motivates a capital/maintenance lower-bound order of magnitude, not empirical plant calibration, a fitted distribution, or a complete startup-fuel estimate.
objective: Original total dispatch, no-load, startup and shutdown costs retained; no objective constant or baseline is subtracted.
metric: Full optimal original cost / returned original cost; arithmetic mean over valid returned points. Recovery denominator is all360 costs, ratio denominators are explicit.
global_gate: Verify completed entire three-seed screen, all three n32 training/affine/model receipts, artifact hashes, reconstructed source bindings, and this source/protocol. Freeze all3seeds×3methods before any confirmation RNG or bank access. Run requires the explicit expected global-freeze SHA256.
training_rule: No model is retrained. Load saved original n32 affine, SVM and MLOPT artifacts only; retain original u/v/w integrality and common-u matching.
reference: Each cold original Full HiGHS IP must have valid original UC physics and matching primal/dual optimum; threads1,30s, no warm start.
failure_rule: Retain all seeds and failures. Never replace confirmation costs, alter the law or select a favorable subset. Late returns are retained diagnostically and excluded from valid-ratio means.
historical_training_times: Read archived learning timers and original label timing sources; do not substitute reload or confirmation time for learning time.
